body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, learn its highest Defense and make it Exposed until the start of your next turn. Ties are reported as ties.

surges.html: An ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense against the target's next attack until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When the target changes position before your next turn, you may move 1 unit toward a space with a clear view of it.
